subject.title: feat(feeds): refresh and manage followed publishers

question: Should signed publisher-feed following, persistence, scheduling, CLI commands, and Gateway RPCs be a supported OpenClaw core control plane, or should this workflow be delivered as a ClawHub/plugin integration behind existing generic seams?
rationale: This is a new user-facing control plane and persistent core surface, not a narrow repair; repository policy reserves optional service workflows for plugins unless maintainers intentionally approve a generic core boundary.

options.title: Keep it plugin-owned
options.body: Move the publisher-specific runtime, CLI, and service workflow into a ClawHub/plugin package, retaining only any narrowly proven generic core seam.

options.title: Sponsor core support
options.body: Explicitly approve this as a supported core publisher-feed control plane, then require public contract docs, upgrade review, and configured-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the stacked publisher-feed work until product ownership and the supported integration model are decided.

recommendation.title: Keep it plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Move the publisher-specific runtime, CLI, and service workflow into a ClawHub/plugin package, retaining only any narrowly proven generic core seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They assembled the active stacked implementation and can supply the design context, although a repository owner must make the final product decision.
